data: For fiscal 2025, Microsoft's gross profit was much larger than NVIDIA's, by about 1.98 times. Microsoft's fiscal 2025 ended June 30, 2025. It reported revenue of about $281.7 billion and cost of revenue of about $87.8 billion, for a gross profit of roughly $193.9 billion and a gross margin near 68.8%. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 ended January 26, 2025. It posted revenue of about $130.5 billion against cost of revenue of about $32.6 billion, for a gross profit of roughly $97.9 billion and a higher gross margin of about 75.0%. So NVIDIA converts a larger share of each sales dollar into gross profit, but Microsoft's much bigger revenue base gives it nearly twice the gross profit in dollars. The two fiscal years end about five months apart, so the periods do not line up exactly.
